about: Every OBP-API call OBP-MCP makes on its own: verb, path (OBP placeholders in capitals), the source file and the text that makes the call (needles), and the response fields the code reads. These are the meta calls (root, glossary, resource docs, swagger). Versions come from OBP_VERSION_TO_CALL and API_VERSION_OF_INTEREST; the paths record their default, DEFAULT_API_VERSION in database/obp_utils.py. The call_obp_api tool is not listed: it calls whatever endpoint the user picks from the index, on a path read from the resource docs (moved up to v5.1.0 by the floor in src/tools/endpoint_index.py). Calls to Keycloak and OBP-OIDC (JWKS, client registration) are not OBP-API calls. tests/test_obp_api_contract.py checks this list against the source and against snapshot.json, which obp-api-contract/snapshot.py writes from an OBP-API's resource docs.
